    (1) Two mutually exclusive events having positive probabilities are \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ dependent. \
    **[A.]{.underline}** Always\
    B. Sometimes\
    C. Never\
    \
    (2)  \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ is a measure of the chance that an uncertain event will occur. \

    (3)  In which of the following are the two events A and B, always independent? \
    A. A and B are mutually exclusive\

    D. P(A\|B)=P(A)\
    **[E.]{.underline}** B and D\
    \

    A. Divide\
    B. Add\
    **[C.]{.underline}** Multiply\
    D. Subtract\
    \
    (5) Events that have no sample space outcomes in common and therefore, cannot occur simultaneously are: \
    A. Independent\
    **[B.]{.underline}** Mutually Exclusive\
    C. Intersections\
    D. Unions\
    \
